01A century of the Chamber

1925 → 2026

Founded in Calcutta in 1925 under the leadership of G.D. Birla, the Indian Chamber of Commerce has spent a hundred years as the bridge between Indian enterprise and government — from the boardrooms of the freedom movement to the reforms that opened India to the world.

Now, a new chapter begins in the heart of India.

02Why Madhya Pradesh

India's next growth engine.

The case for Madhya Pradesh is not sentiment — it is arithmetic. A ₹16-lakh-crore economy growing faster than the national rate, seated at the geographic centre of every corridor that matters.

Madhya Pradesh within India

The heart of India — and the crossing of its corridors.

  • 5states share a border with Madhya Pradesh — Uttar Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Gujarat and Rajasthan.
  • 2ndlargest state in India by area — 308,000 sq km sitting squarely at the centre of the map.
  • 2national arteries run straight through it — the Delhi–Mumbai Expressway and the Delhi–Mumbai Industrial Corridor.

04Transformation Ideas

Rapid-fire ideas. A working agenda.

  1. 01

    Leaders take the stage

    Sector by sector, Madhya Pradesh's business leaders step up — no panels, no preambles.

  2. 02

    Each presents transformative ideas

    Two bold, actionable ideas per sector, delivered rapid-fire — in minutes, not hours.

  3. 03

    Ideas become the agenda

    The best ideas are adopted as the council's working agenda for its first year.

12 leaders. 24 ideas. One morning that sets the state's agenda.
